name: Chila (Cheela)
instructions: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine rice flour and a small portion of gram flour for binding.
2. Add ginger-garlic paste, finely chopped green chilies, cumin seeds, salt, and chopped coriander leaves.
3. Gradually add water to create a thin, smooth, pourable batter and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
4. Heat a flat iron griddle (tawa) and grease it lightly with mustard oil.
5. Pour a ladleful of batter in the center and spread it in a circular motion to form a thin crepe.
6. Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook on medium heat until the base turns golden brown and crispy.
7. Carefully flip and cook the other side for a minute, then serve hot with tomato chutney or pickles.
description: Chila is a staple breakfast dish in Chhattisgarh, reflecting the state's agrarian culture centered around rice cultivation. It is a humble, nutritious, and quick-to-prepare comfort food often enjoyed by families to start their day, representing the rustic and flavorful culinary heritage of the region.
